description:
Job Specification: Load Planner

Department / Location: Transport, Halifax
Reports To: Transport Manager
People Responsibility: Drivers and Mates

Main Purpose

To manage day-to-day transport operations, including driver allocation, route planning and transport administration, ensuring customer service requirements are met efficiently and within budget.

Key Responsibilities
- Allocate work to drivers and mates to maximise vehicle utilisation and workforce efficiency, monitoring performance and taking corrective action where necessary.
- Ensure drivers and mates follow company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and established working practices.
- Plan daily delivery routes using Paragon, ensuring the appropriate vehicles are deployed to meet customer requirements while minimising costs.
- Ensure loads remain within vehicle payload limits and comply with drivers' hours regulations.
- Ensure drivers and mates receive appropriate inductions and training, maintaining accurate records and identifying further training needs.
- Ensure vehicles and associated equipment are operated safely and in accordance with current legislation and company policies.
- Produce transport performance reports and KPIs accurately and on time for internal and external use.
- Ensure compliance with Health and Safety and fire safety regulations, including the correct use of company uniforms and personal protective equipment (PPE).
- Complete order processing and prepare pick lists, despatch notes and load sheets in accordance with depot procedures.
- Provide support to warehouse management when required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
- On-time delivery performance.
- Vehicle fill rates and payload utilisation.
- Delivery cost per drop.
- Driver compliance, including drivers' hours and vehicle walk-round checks.
- Completion of training and up-to-date induction records.

Key Working Relationships

Internal
- Transport Manager
- Warehouse Team
- Customer Service Team
- Fleet and Maintenance Team

External
- Customers
- Hauliers and third-party carriers
- Paragon system support

Qualifications, Skills and Experience
- Previous experience in transport planning, ideally using Paragon.
- Working knowledge of drivers' hours regulations and operator licence requirements.
- Strong IT, organisational and communication skills.
- Ability to work under pressure and meet daily delivery deadlines.
- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to work effectively with drivers, warehouse teams and other departments.
- A proactive approach to improving transport efficiency and customer service.

title: Medical receptionist
description: We are recruiting for a medical receptionist to join our friendly and busy team. This role provides reception and administrative support to the whole practice. Customer service experience and IT skills are essential. A knowledge of primary care and the IT system (System One) would be an advantage but not essential as training is provided. Good written and oral communication skills are also essential as well as good time management and organisational skills to prioritise your workload, along with an understand of, and commitment to, patient confidentiality. Welcoming patients to the surgery and providing a friendly and professional reception service.Answering incoming telephone calls promptly and dealing with a wide range of patient queries. Booking, cancelling and rearranging GP, nurse and other clinical appointments. Supporting patients with general enquiries and directing them to the appropriate service. Take accurate messages and relaying information to the relevant team members. Managing the reception area and assisting patients with check-in and other administrative queries. Liaising with GPs, nurses, administrative staff and other healthcare professionals. Maintaining accurate and confidential patient records. Handling sensitive and sometimes challenging conversations calmly, respectfully and professionally. Following practice procedures relating to confidentiality, safeguarding, information governance and patient care. Carrying out general administrative duties to support the smooth running of the practice. Please see receptionist job description attached to this advert in supporting documents. title: Patient Services Administrator
description: At Northgate Surgery, our Patient Service Administrators play a vital role in supporting the smooth and effective delivery of primary care services. Working alongside our Patient Service Advisors, GPs, nurses, management team, and external healthcare providers, you will be responsible for a wide range of administrative duties that directly contribute to patient care and the efficient running of the practice. This is a varied and rewarding role suited to an organised, detail-focused individual who enjoys working in a busy healthcare environment. The successful candidate will support key administrative functions including the processing of medical reports, private work, patient records management, prescription administration, clinical correspondence, and results enquiries. The hours for this role are Monday,Tuesday, Thursday, Friday 9-5 and Wednesdays 8:30-4 The successful candidate will be responsible for: Processing and coordinating Insurance, GP Reports (IGPR), Subject Access Requests, and other medical report requests. Administering private work requests, including private letters, medical examinations, insurance documentation, and associated invoicing. Managing prescription-related queries in accordance with practice procedures and policies. Processing and responding to patient and healthcare professional test results enquiries in line with practice protocols. Scanning, coding, and processing incoming correspondence and clinical documentation. Maintaining accurate electronic patient records and ensuring information is updated appropriately. Supporting the summarisation and management of patient medical records. Monitoring and managing clinical administration workflows and shared practice inboxes. Liaising with hospitals, pharmacies, community services, and other healthcare organisations regarding administrative matters. Producing routine correspondence, reports, and documentation as required. Supporting quality improvement initiatives, enhanced services, and contractual requirements. Maintaining confidentiality and ensuring compliance with GDPR, Information Governance, and practice policies. Working collaboratively with colleagues across the practice to ensure administrative work is completed accurately and within agreed timescales.

title: GP Receptionist / Care Navigator
description: We are recruiting for a Care Navigator to join our team. The role will be part time, and you must be available to work Friday evenings up until 18:30pm. Working within the Robin Lane reception team, the post-holder will help provide a friendly and welcoming service for all patients. The Care Navigator will support patients to access the right health care in a professional and efficient manner. Follow practice processes to actively signpost patients to the most appropriate healthcare professional and service, whilst handling any complex queries and challenging situations in a professional manner, ensuring any issues are resolved where possible, at the first point of contact. Assist both clinical and admin colleagues with the smooth running of the reception area and surgery building.The post-holder is expected to comply with the employment policies and procedures, with due regard to clinical and information governance policies and procedures, and any other policies and procedures necessary for the safe and effective discharge of the duties contained within this document. This job description is subject to a flexibility clause and may change according to business requirements. This advert may close early should the right candidate be found. To welcome patients presenting either in person or by telephone; ensuring you respond promptly and positively. Book appointments for patients and cancel appointments where needed. Support patients in navigating to the most appropriate service, which may include informing patients of external health care providers and online services. Effectively handle all queries that present at the practice; problem solving, signposting and escalation of matters, as appropriate. Ensure patient records are accurate and kept up to date and that all patient contacts are documented in the system using the Care Navigation Template. Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare providers. Carrying out administrative duties which include scanning, tasks, out of hours reports, new patient registrations (including basic urine dip), opening and sorting of post (both internal and external), photocopying reports, updating patient details, filing INR reports and data inputting as requested. Processing medication requests, including issuing repeat medication and appliance items, as well as forwarding patient requests onto the practice pharmacy team/on-call GP. Communicating effectively with local pharmacy staff and resolving/investigating any queries they may have. Processing e-consults via system one and triaging the patient accordingly using signposting where necessary. Opening up/locking up of practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with practice protocols. Carry out chronic disease recalls and vaccination campaigns, booking relevant appointments working from a list to ensure clinics are fully utilised Informing patients of test results and following up with instructions from clinicians. Keeping the reception area and notice boards clean, tidy and up to date. Taking payments for private documents from patients and providing receipts Support all clinical staff with general tasks as required. Assisting the Site Co-ordinator with weekly fire alarm checks and weekly/monthly legionella testing, when required. Assisting the Site Co-ordinator with weekly room plans and petty cash records, when required. title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are looking for an enthusiastic and organised Medical Receptionist 2 x 20 hours per week or 1 x 37.5 hours to provide temporary maternity cover within our friendly and supportive practice. You will receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. This is a front-line role, ideal for someone who is professional, approachable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced healthcare environment. The position can be offered as one full-time post or shared between two part-time staff, depending on availability and suitability. Receiving calls and assisting with direct face to face patient enquiries are predominant parts of this role, therefore this will be very suited to people with previous customer facing roles. Day to day varies from booking appointments, processing medication requests, dealing with patients who want to register at the practice and dealing with general enquiries, signposting them to the most appropriate appointment or service. Good communication skills are vital for the role and basic IT skills will be needed. Job Summary: Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. Provide general assistance to the Practice team and project a positive, friendly and courteous image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone. Process repeat prescription requests from patients. Scan in correspondence to the clinical database and workflow to the GPs. Job Responsibilities: Be familiar with the Practice computer and be able to input data as required. To have knowledge of the Practice area/boundary. To know under which circumstances clinical and non-clinical advice should be sought. Handle incoming and outgoing telephone calls in a polite and efficient manner. Ensure all messages are passed to the appropriate team member, and colleagues made aware of any action required. Be able to cover all reception positions as necessary. Provide additional cover for the reception office during periods of holiday or sickness. Reception Receiving patients consulting with members of practice team. Keep reception areas tidy at all times. Accepting requests for repeat prescriptions, checking the fax and prescription box for repeat prescription requests Handover to incoming staff patient information on any issues not yet completed. To deal with visitors and tradesmen appropriately. To ensure the timely notification of all deliveries to the relevant staff. Administration Pulling/filing medical records and update as necessary. Download and file electronic patient correspondence received in medical records. Photocopy and laminate documents as requested. Scanning duties Sort and date stamp all incoming patient-related mail. Scan patient-related documents onto their medical record using read codes as agreed by the clinical team Add any additional information about the source of the document Forward the document to the doctor or nurse who initiated the referral or who is most appropriate to receive the information Ensure incoming letters are scanned onto the patient record within a 48/72-hour timescale Scan all internal paper documents on to the relevant patients record and then store the documents in line with surgery procedures. Coding Identify relevant clinical information contained in patient correspondence Code or free text the clinical information on to the patient record Deal with queries relating to coding Appointments Process appointment requests for today and future appointments from patients by telephone and in person. Deal with visit requests and produce any documentation required for the doctors. Arrange and record hospital transport requests. Computer Carry out data input, ensuring that the recording of all relevant information into the patients electronic medical record is accurate and concise. Registration of new patients computer data entry and medical records. Process patients change of address computer data and medical records. Process applications from patients for online Patient Access. Process repeat prescription requests in accordance with practice guidelines. Telephone Have working knowledge of telephone system, during and after hours. Other Tasks Ensure building security have thorough knowledge of doors/windows/alarm. Open up premises at the start of the day if the first to arrive and make all necessary preparations to receive patients. Make refreshments (tea/coffee) for doctors and colleagues. Any other tasks allocated by the Partners or Practice Manager. Confidentiality : In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately. In the performance of the duties outlined in this Job Description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential. Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data. Health & Safety : The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice Health & Safety Policy, to include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines. Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks. Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills. Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards. Reporting potential risks identified. Personal/professional development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Equality and Diversity : The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognizes the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies, and current legislation. Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues. Behaving in a manner, which is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/Professional Development : Mandatory training courses, i.e. fire safety, safeguarding, CPR etc. Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development. Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work. Quality : The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk. Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision. Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance. Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs. Effectively manage own time, workload and resources. Communication : The post-holder should recognise the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members, patients and carers. Recognise peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly. Contribution to the Implementation of Services : The post-holder will: Work in accordance with practice policies, standards and guidance. Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work. Make use of information technology systems available within the Practice, following systems for data security and protection. Participate in audit where appropriate. Attend and participate in practice meetings/training events. Any other duties commensurate with the role to ensure the smooth running of the Practice. title: Care Navigator/ Medical Receptionist
description: South Queen Street Medical Centre are looking to appoint a care navigator/ receptionist to join our busy GP practice who will be the first point of contact for patients, contractors, and visitors as well as carrying out general office management tasks. Working pattern 5 hours per day, 5 days a week, alternate weekly am & pm shifts, 8am-630pm. Flexibility and overtime will be required for this role. You will be responsible for the general reception duties within the Practice and work with our established processes, policies, and procedures to provide a comprehensive high-quality service and deal efficiently and courteously with patient enquiries. You will receive, assist, and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. You will provide general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone. You will have excellent communication skills, a compassionate and friendly nature who can operate in a busy environment with a range of people and professions, as you will be working with our clinical and administration teams. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organised and an effective communicator who can provide a professional and warm welcome to our patients, ensuring every contact is of the highest quality. IT skills are essential, as you will be regularly creating searches, data input and monitoring our achievements and progress against national, local, and internal targets. You will also process prescription requests and provide a full administrative service. GCSE grade C or above in English and Maths is essential for this role. Key Duties and Responsibilities Patient Reception and Customer Service Act as the first point of contact for patients, visitors and healthcare professionals, both face-to-face and over the telephone. Welcome patients in a friendly, respectful and professional manner. Respond to general enquiries and provide accurate information about practice services, opening hours and appointment procedures. Deal sensitively with patients who may be anxious, distressed, frustrated or experiencing difficult personal circumstances. Maintain a clean, organised and welcoming reception and waiting area. Manage challenging situations professionally and escalate complaints or concerns to the appropriate member of the practice team. Care Navigation and Appointment Management Handle patient requests for appointments, advice and access to healthcare services by telephone and in person. Use approved care navigation protocols to direct patients to the most appropriate clinician or service, including GPs, practice nurses, clinical pharmacists, physiotherapists and other available services where appropriate. Gather relevant non-clinical information to help determine the appropriate appointment pathway, without attempting to diagnose medical conditions. Book, amend and cancel appointments using the practices clinical computer system. Identify potentially urgent concerns in accordance with practice procedures and promptly escalate them to a clinician. Provide information about alternative services, such as NHS 111, where appropriate and in accordance with practice guidance. Maintain accurate records of patient contacts and appointment requests. Telephone and Administrative Duties Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and manage a busy call queue efficiently. Handle patient messages and ensure they are passed to the appropriate member of the clinical or administrative team. Process repeat prescription requests in accordance with practice policies and direct medication queries to the appropriate professional. Register new patients and update demographic details, contact information and other relevant records. Manage incoming and outgoing post, emails and electronic communications. Assist with administrative tasks, including recalling patients for appointments, supporting clinical audits and maintaining accurate practice records. Monitor outstanding administrative tasks and follow up requests within agreed timescales. Clinical Systems and Data Management Use the practices electronic clinical system, SystmOne, to access and update patient information. Ensure patient details, appointment information and messages are recorded accurately and promptly. Handle sensitive patient information securely and maintain strict confidentiality at all times. Comply with UK GDPR, data protection legislation, information governance requirements and practice policies. Follow procedures for accessing, storing and sharing patient information appropriately. Teamwork and Practice Support Work collaboratively with GPs, nurses, healthcare assistants, pharmacists, care coordinators and administrative colleagues. Attend staff meetings and training sessions as required. Support colleagues during busy periods and assist with the day-to-day organisation of reception services. Follow practice policies relating to health and safety, infection prevention, safeguarding and equality and diversity. Report incidents, risks and concerns to the appropriate manager. Undertake other reasonable duties appropriate to the role to support the effective operation of the practice. Training and Development The successful candidate will receive induction and training appropriate to the role, including practice procedures, clinical systems, information governance, confidentiality, safeguarding, health and safety and care navigation. Ongoing training and development will be encouraged to support the delivery of a safe, efficient and high-quality patient service. Personal Qualities We are looking for someone who is approachable, empathetic, dependable and proactive. The successful candidate must demonstrate patience, discretion and professionalism when dealing with sensitive situations and be committed to treating every patient with dignity, respect and fairness. Working Conditions The postholder will work within a busy GP practice and may be required to work flexibly according to the needs of the service. Working hours, salary, annual leave and other employment terms will be confirmed during recruitment.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Kensington Partnership is seeking a friendly, professional and organised Medical Receptionist to join our busy GP practice team. The successful candidate will provide efficient reception and administrative support, ensuring patients receive a welcoming and professional service. Excellent communication, IT and organisational skills are essential, along with the ability to work under pressure, use initiative and work effectively as part of a team. Previous NHS, GP reception or SystmOne experience is desirable, but full training will be provided. Flexibility to cover staff absences and work across practice sites where required is also desirable. Recruitment Process Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a pre-interview information session on Thursday, 19 November 2026, from 1:00 pm to 3:00 pm , to gain a better understanding of the role and its expectations. Those who remain interested will be invited to a formal interview at a later date. You will join a supportive, forward-thinking team, delivering professional and compassionate patient services within a busy primary care environment. With most incoming calls managed through our AI system, the role primarily involves handling face-to-face enquiries, supporting AI-assisted triage and providing administrative support. Responsibilities include reviewing and processing patient requests, maintaining accurate records, directing enquiries to appropriate teams and escalating clinical concerns in accordance with practice procedures. Occasional telephone duties may also be required. A courteous, confidential and patient-centred approach is essential at all times. Reception and Patient Services Welcome patients and manage face-to-face enquiries professionally and courteously. Handle calls transferred by the AI telephone system requiring receptionist assistance. Support AI-assisted triage by reviewing and processing patient requests in line with practice procedures. Book appointments following triage outcomes and provide appropriate care navigation. Signpost patients to relevant services and escalate urgent or complex concerns to the clinical team. Administration and Practice Support Maintain accurate patient records using SystmOne and other practice systems. Process correspondence, home visit requests, ambulance transport and interpreter bookings. Handle payments, receipts, deliveries and general administrative duties. Provide day-to-day administrative support to GPs, clinical staff and colleagues. Communication and Teamwork Communicate professionally and compassionately with patients, carers, colleagues and external agencies. Work collaboratively and flexibly across practice sites as required. Support patients with additional communication or accessibility needs. Undertake chaperone duties when appropriately trained and authorised. Confidentiality and Information Governance Maintain strict confidentiality and access patient records only when authorised and necessary. Comply with UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018 and practice information governance policies. Promptly report suspected data breaches, security incidents or confidentiality concerns. General Responsibilities Assist with opening and securing practice premises when authorised. Maintain a safe, tidy and welcoming reception environment. Follow safeguarding, infection prevention, health and safety, and other practice policies. Complete mandatory training and undertake other reasonable duties appropriate to the role.
